other_code: Same current worktree, including prior correction-bit and activity-mask fixes.
platform: WSL Ubuntu 24.04, Intel Core i7-13700H, GCC 13.3.0, -O2 AES-NI/AVX2
timed_operation: Both parties' complete reusable Expand calls over LocalAsyncSocket on one thread, including allocation/reuse, messages, leaf conversion, corrections, routing and output writes.
repetitions: Two fresh runs per build/profile in before/after/after/before order. Each run: 3 warmups, 15 measured expansions. Table averages the two per-run medians.
validation: All 216 expanded outputs checked pointwise. Bytes per expansion unchanged in both builds.
setup_interpretation: One-time setPoints timings are recorded separately; their between-run spread does not resolve the small added root-derivation cost.
interpretation: Combined rekeying plus AES batching comparison, not rekeying alone. Small 3N difference is within local run-to-run variation. Not a portable benchmark or paper benchmark replacement.
